description:
· Build low level design for application development based on the high level architecture

 · Produce low level design documents & own up specific modules. 
 · Develop custom code for salesforce.com application. 
 · Strong expertise in Apex, Visualforce is a must. 
 · Design and develop custom code for data migration and integration. 
 · Strong expertise on various Salesforce.com APIs like SOAP, REST, BULK, and Streaming API is a must. 
 · Strong expertise on working with various ETL looks like Informatica, Pervasive, Dell Boomi, and Data Stage. 
 · Develop entity and data mapping for data integration and migration. 
 · Develop and document unit testing scenarios. 
 
 · Adhere to best practices defined by the Architects during build. 
 · Knowledge of working with Config management tools like sub version &Git Hub. 
 · Should be able to use Eclipse IDE, Change Sets & ANT Scripts for code migration 
 · Ability to manage small onsite & offshore teams. 

 Bachelor degree in Computer Science or related work experience. 


 Note : NO OPT, H1 for this position 

 Client : Infosys
